parsed.post: Increased DEPTH from 4 to 6. Val_bpb dropped from 1.099770 to 1.067257. Larger models seem to converge better within the 5-minute window. Next: testing if increasing MATRIX_LR further or adding WARMUP helps stabilize this larger depth.
parsed.description: Increasing depth to 6, increasing matrix learning rate to 0.1, and adding 5% warmup to stabilize the higher LR.
